record.bible_text: <FI> Is there<Fi> not an appointed time<WH06635> to man<WH0582> upon earth<WH0776>? <FI>are not<Fi> his days<WH03117> also like the days<WH03117> of an hireling<WH07916>? <RF>an appointed...: or, a warfare<Rf>

As a servant<WH05650> earnestly desireth<WH07602><WTH8799> the shadow<WH06738>, and as an hireling<WH07916> looketh<WH06960><WTH8762> for <FI>the reward of<Fi> his work<WH06467>: <RF>earnestly...: Heb. gapeth after<Rf>
So am I made to possess<WH05157><WTH8717> months<WH03391> of vanity<WH07723>, and wearisome<WH05999> nights<WH03915> are appointed<WH04487><WTH8765> to me.

When I lie down<WH07901><WTH8804>, I say<WH0559><WTH8804>, When shall I arise<WH06965><WTH8799>, and the night<WH06153> be gone<WH04059>? and I am full<WH07646><WTH8804> of tossings to and fro<WH05076> unto the dawning of the day<WH05399>. <RF>the night...: Heb. the evening be measured?<Rf>
My flesh<WH01320> is clothed<WH03847><WTH8804> with worms<WH07415> and clods<WH01487> of dust<WH06083>; my skin<WH05785> is broken<WH07280><WTH8804>, and become loathsome<WH03988><WTH8735>.
My days<WH03117> are swifter<WH07043><WTH8804> than a weaver's shuttle<WH0708>, and are spent<WH03615><WTH8799> without<WH0657> hope<WH08615>.<CM>

O remember<WH02142><WTH8798> that my life<WH02416> <FI>is<Fi> wind<WH07307>: mine eye<WH05869> shall no more<WH07725><WTH8799> see<WH07200><WTH8800> good<WH02896>. <RF>shall...: Heb. shall not return<Rf> <RF>see: to see, that is, to enjoy<Rf>

The eye<WH05869> of him that hath seen<WH07210> me shall see<WH07789><WTH8799> me no <FI>more<Fi> : thine eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> upon me, and I <FI>am<Fi> not. <RF>I am...: that is, I can live no longer<Rf>

<FI> As<Fi> the cloud<WH06051> is consumed<WH03615><WTH8804> and vanisheth away<WH03212><WTH8799>: so he that goeth down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the grave<WH07585> shall come up<WH05927><WTH8799> no <FI>more<Fi> .
He shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> no more to his house<WH01004>, neither shall his place<WH04725> know<WH05234><WTH8686> him any more.

Therefore I will not refrain<WH02820><WTH8799> my mouth<WH06310>; I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762> in the anguish<WH06862> of my spirit<WH07307>; I will complain<WH07878><WTH8799> in the bitterness<WH04751> of my soul<WH05315>.
<FI> Am<Fi> I a sea<WH03220>, or a whale<WH08577>, that thou settest<WH07760><WTH8799> a watch<WH04929> over me?
When I say<WH0559><WTH8804>, My bed<WH06210> shall comfort<WH05162><WTH8762> me, my couch<WH04904> shall ease<WH05375><WTH8799> my complaint<WH07879>;
Then thou scarest<WH02865><WTH8765> me with dreams<WH02472>, and terrifiest<WH01204><WTH8762> me through visions<WH02384>:
So that my soul<WH05315> chooseth<WH0977><WTH8799> strangling<WH04267>, <FI>and<Fi> death<WH04194> rather than my life<WH06106>. <RF>life: Heb. bones<Rf>
I loathe<WH03988><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> ; I would not live<WH02421><WTH8799> alway<WH05769>: let me alone<WH02308><WTH8798>; for my days<WH03117> <FI>are<Fi> vanity<WH01892>.<CM>
What <FI>is<Fi> man<WH0582>, that thou shouldest magnify<WH01431><WTH8762> him? and that thou shouldest set<WH07896><WTH8799> thine heart<WH03820> upon him?
And <FI>that<Fi> thou shouldest visit<WH06485><WTH8799> him every morning<WH01242>, <FI>and<Fi> try<WH0974><WTH8799> him every moment<WH07281>?
How long<WH04100> wilt thou not depart<WH08159><WTH8799> from me, nor let me alone<WH07503><WTH8686> till I swallow down<WH01104><WTH8800> my spittle<WH07536>?

I have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804>; what shall I do<WH06466><WTH8799> unto thee, O thou preserver<WH05341><WTH8802> of men<WH0120>? why hast thou set<WH07760><WTH8804> me as a mark<WH04645> against thee, so that I am a burden<WH04853> to myself?

And why dost thou not pardon<WH05375><WTH8799> my transgression<WH06588>, and take away<WH05674><WTH8686> mine iniquity<WH05771>? for now shall I sleep<WH07901><WTH8799> in the dust<WH06083>; and thou shalt seek me in the morning<WH07836><WTH8765>, but I <FI>shall<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> .<CM>
